Difference identified-set [L1-U0,U1-L0]. CIs for endpoints clustered at plant; Bonferroni simultaneous95% two-endpoint outer interval.

scientific_limits: Observed monthly mass series uses upstream calibration, truncation, and within-month reconstruction. Not raw complete physical emissions.
Monitoring availability is a process outcome; improvement cannot be labelled proven physical reduction by itself.
Original342sample and exact randomization mechanism need documentation; do not inventblockpermutation.
Novelty relative to original extensive reporting analysis must be confirmed before manuscript.
PM is notCO2 and notfullCSR; noclaims aboutglobalcarbonfootprint, profits, or causalcapitalinvestment.
